certification.name: NYU Introduction to Cyber Security Specialization
certification.description: Four-course New York University specialization covering cyber attacks and risk analysis, authentication and cryptography, network security and firewalls, and enterprise security and compliance frameworks. Course-based certificate assessed through quizzes and projects, with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 2 months at 10 hours a week.
